summary: Recorded the persistence behavior entry as a use of its own question, then scoped the main ReadIndex defect to the public client surface: NodeHost.SyncRead and NodeHost.ReadIndex both register their batch through the same internal read helper and node.read, the shared result mapping returns ErrTimeout at the caller's deadline for a stranded batch and ErrClusterNotReady only for a dropped one, and ReadLocalNode refuses to read without the ready flag. Added eight source ranges, one behavior entry, a child question of the main ReadIndex question and a source-only explanation that makes no separate defect claim. Validation reports valid, no_change false, no execution requested.
